lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a higher density and larger diameter relative to the cephalic spots, following the lateral curvature of the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a coordinate-like grid, with the highest-intensity blobs positioned at these structural intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance (dorsal) to shadowed low-luminance (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of micro-blobs is visible across the rostrum and perioral region, with a specific radial arrangement of spots observed on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
